workday.notClaimed: general ERP, finance, procurement, inventory, or order management

security: All connections use the existing tenant/workspace/owner/visibility/revision control plane and encrypted credential_ref storage.
Browser and Agent payloads receive redacted profiles, not ERP credentials.
Agent leases accept only actions belonging to the selected ERP provider and deny legacy generic/write actions.
All new actions are read-only; no write action was added.
Reads enforce maximum 100 pages, 200 rows per page, 50 projected fields, 4 MiB response, 30 second timeout, 8 concurrent requests, and 366 day windows.
Every bounded read requests and returns only its explicit native-field allowlist; Kingdee positional rows are mapped to the requested FieldKeys before output.
Unknown domains and fields return structured unsupported errors.
Redirects fail closed; continuation URLs must remain on the configured origin; guarded fetch checks URL and DNS.

Private SAP/Odoo/Kingdee/Yonyou/ERPNext access requires a per-connection privateRunner opt-in plus CONNECTION_ERP_PRIVATE_RUNNER=true, OOMOL_CONNECT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK=true, and CONNECTION_ERP_EGRESS_ALLOWLIST on the dedicated ERP runner.
Configured company/legal-entity boundaries are reapplied on every page; domains without a safe native company filter are omitted from discovery and return structured unsupported.
Provider error bodies, financial rows, credentials, and personal information are not written to logs or handoff.

verification.requiredFlow: configure -> encrypted credential -> validate -> capability discovery -> two bounded domains -> Agent lease -> audit -> revoke -> delete
